run_encode_images_bits_back: run the encode script to compress images using Bits-Back coding with a pretrained diffusion model
run_decode_compressed_data: run the decode function to reconstruct compressed image batches from Bits-Back encoded data
run_main_with_hydra_config: run the main function with Hydra config to encode and optionally verify decoded image batches
encode_function_usage: encode image batches using a BitsBackCodec by quantizing and pushing data through the codec
decode_function_usage: decode compressed batches from a BitsBackCodec and save them as numpy files to disk
